The '''''Fury''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] that was a part of [[Lumiya's fleet]] shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. It could carry 72 [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]].<ref name="Lumiya: Dark Star of the Empire" />
